entry.title: Roseburg Reminds Candidates, Residents of Campaign Sign Rules Ahead of November Election
entry.summary: Roseburg officials are reminding candidates and residents to follow state and local rules for campaign signs ahead of the Nov. 3 election. Signs are allowed through Nov. 6 and cannot be placed in public rights-of-way, parks, on utility poles or other prohibited areas.

entry.title: Mother, Three Children Killed in Eagle Point Camper Fire
